observations.subject: POST /orders
observations.sentence: `POST /orders`: warm median 1.2 ms over 199 requests; Handler, other work 60 %, Response write 20 %, Other filters 20 %. Median CPU 1.2 ms and 33 KB allocated per request. First request 51 ms (cold).
whatToCheck: Most of the time is in the handler outside recorded calls: run Profile resources to see the route's hottest frames.
Open the slowest exemplar request in Live Activity to see its timeline.
limitations: 199 requests sent Kafka messages: a Kafka send is timed until the broker acknowledges it asynchronously, which the handler does not wait for, so its time is not counted as Message sends.
